screen.features.border_danger.distance.h: Blocks from the world border where damage starts. Applies as you change it.
screen.features.border_danger.distance.v: Where the haze and weather start. The world updates while this menu is open.
screen.features.border_danger.warning.on: Shows the warning when a player nears the border.
screen.features.border_danger.harm.damag: The border deals one heart per second inside the damage zone.
screen.features.border_danger.harm.effec: The border applies the effects you tick, instead of raw damage.
screen.features.border_danger.effect.nau: Adds this effect inside the damage zone.
screen.features.border_danger.effect.wit: Adds this effect inside the damage zone.

screen.features.border_danger.effect.slo: Adds this effect inside the damage zone.
screen.features.border_danger.effect.hun: Adds this effect inside the damage zone.
screen.features.border_danger.effect.wea: Adds this effect inside the damage zone.
screen.features.border_danger.warn_style: The warning is printed in chat.
The warning sits above the hotbar.
The warning sits in the middle of the screen.
screen.features.border_danger.vanilla_re: Keeps the vanilla red vignette near the border.
Turns the vanilla red vignette off.
screen.features.border_danger.warn_color: Blink color before the player enters the zone.
Blink color inside the damage zone.
screen.features.border_danger.barrier.va: The world border keeps the vanilla texture.
screen.features.border_danger.barrier.cu: The border wall uses your PNG.
screen.features.border_danger.fx.haze.ti: A haze fills the danger zone.
screen.features.border_danger.fx.fog.tip: Fog thickens in the danger zone.
screen.features.border_danger.fx.snow.ti: A blizzard plays in the danger zone.
screen.features.border_danger.fx.rain.ti: Heavy rain plays in the danger zone.

message.features.border_danger.barrier.f: Drop a PNG into the opened folder — it reloads automatically
message.features.border_danger.warning.a: You are approaching the danger zone
feature.features.inventory_revamp.desc: Start with just the hotbar. Better armor unlocks more inventory slots.
screen.features.inventory_revamp.hint: Slots unlock from armor. Configure below.
screen.features.inventory_revamp.keep_it: Items stay in the inventory when a bonus slot closes. Default is off.
screen.features.inventory_revamp.bonuses: Item id and slot bonus. Full netherite = 27.
feature.features.mob_spawn_block.desc: Stops chosen mobs from spawning. Pick which ones in settings.
feature.features.border_danger.desc: The world border is dangerous — damage or effects. Tune the zone in settings.
feature.features.hud_hide.desc: Hides HUD parts: hearts, hunger, armor, hotbar, and crosshair.
Hides the health hearts. The HUD updates as soon as you toggle it.
screen.features.hud_hide.style.fade.tip: The element fades out where it is.
screen.features.hud_hide.style.slide.tip: The element slides down off the screen.
Pops in briefly, then fades out
Pops in briefly, then slides off-screen
Hearts come back briefly when health changes.
The hunger bar comes back briefly when hunger changes.
Armor icons come back briefly when armor changes.
The hotbar comes back briefly when you switch items.
The XP bar comes back briefly when experience changes.
Effect icons come back briefly when effects change.
screen.features.hud_hide.admin.off.tip: Any player can open this menu.
feature.features.f3_hide.desc: Cleans up the F3 screen. Keep only the lines you need.
screen.features.f3_hide.hint: Checked = hide this line group from F3
screen.features.f3_hide.hide_all.tip: Hides every debug line. The preview updates immediately.
screen.features.f3_hide.category.importa: Hides or shows every line in this group.
screen.features.f3_hide.category.other.t: Hides or shows every line in this group.
screen.features.f3_hide.line.tip: Hides this line on the debug screen. The preview updates immediately.
screen.features.f3_hide.admin.on.tip: Players cannot change the debug lines.
feature.features.hide_names.desc: Hides player name tags. Choose how they can reappear.
screen.features.hide_names.mode.full.des: Name tags stay hidden for everyone.
screen.features.hide_names.mode.proximit: Names fade in as you get closer.
screen.features.hide_names.mode.look_clo: Show a name only when looking at that player up close.
screen.features.hide_names.mode.masks.de: Hide names only for players wearing listed head items.
screen.features.hide_names.admin.on.tip: Players cannot change the admin options.
feature.features.real_first_person.desc: See your full body in first person. Works with custom animations and TacZ when present.
screen.features.real_first_person.hint: Body uses the normal player model — armor, skin, and animation mods apply.
Only body arms. Vanilla floating hands are hidden.
Hide vanilla hands normally; keep them while swimming or gliding.
Keep vanilla first-person hands on top of the body.
screen.features.real_first_person.hide_h: Hides your own head so it does not fill the camera.
Arrows and bee stingers stay visible in first person.
screen.features.real_first_person.compat: Warning: First-person Model is also loaded — disable one.
feature.features.true_night.desc: Nights get truly dark. Torches and the moon still light the way.
screen.features.true_night.hint: Block light is unchanged. Sky light follows the mode below.
screen.features.true_night.fog.on.tip: Rolls a fog bank on some nights. The sky updates while this menu is open.
screen.features.true_night.fog.chance.ti: How often a fog bank starts. A dot means this is not the default.
screen.features.true_night.fog.min.tip: The lightest a fog bank can be.
screen.features.true_night.fog.max.tip: The thickest a fog bank can be.
feature.features.local_chat.desc: Chat is heard nearby. Start a message with ! to talk to everyone.
screen.features.local_chat.locked: Only operators can change these settings.
screen.features.local_chat.hint: Normal messages reach players within range.
screen.features.local_chat.range.value.t: How far a normal message carries. Default is 100. A dot means it was changed.
screen.features.local_chat.bypass.on.tip: Operators hear local messages from the whole map.
screen.features.local_chat.bypass.hint: When on, ops see local messages from anywhere.
feature.features.wetness.desc: Rain, snow, and water soak you. Armor slows you when wet. Dry on land or by a fire — or you may freeze.
screen.features.wetness.locked: Only operators can change these settings.
screen.features.wetness.hint: Rates are %/s. Wading is 2× rain/snow; full submersion is instant.
screen.features.wetness.rain.tip: How fast rain soaks a player. Default is 1.
screen.features.wetness.dry.tip: How fast wetness leaves on dry land. Default is 1.
screen.features.wetness.heat_torch.tip: Drying speed near a torch. Default is 1.5.
screen.features.wetness.heat_fire.tip: Drying speed near fire. Default is 2.
screen.features.wetness.heat_lava.tip: Drying speed near lava. Default is 3.
screen.features.wetness.heat_radius.tip: How far heat sources are noticed. Default is 4.
screen.features.wetness.freeze.tip: Seconds of being wet on land before freezing. Default is 240.
screen.features.wetness.armor_slow.tip: Speed lost while wet and wearing armor. Default is 20%.
feature.features.item_remover.desc: Removes chosen items from crafting, loot, trades, and inventories.
feature.features.command_blocker.desc: Hides and denies chosen commands for players, moderators, or operators.
screen.features.command_blocker.hint: Role, then the command. Example: gamemode blocks that command. give * blocks give and anything after it. * is one word. Players / mods / operators.
feature.features.interaction_blocker.des: Stops players from opening, using, right-clicking, or breaking chosen blocks and entities.
screen.features.interaction_blocker.hint: Search a block or entity and click it. #minecraft:doors is a tag. @farmersdelight is every block from that mod.
feature.features.tool_restrictions.desc: Mineable blocks break only with the matching tool.
screen.features.tool_restrictions.locked: Only operators can change tool rules.
screen.features.tool_restrictions.hint: Exceptions ignore the tool rule. Hand is what an empty hand may break. Use a block id or #minecraft:logs. Creative is unchanged.
feature.features.portal_lock.desc: Allow, block, or time-lock nether, end, and modded portals.
screen.features.portal_lock.locked: Only operators can change portal rules.
screen.features.portal_lock.hint: Pick a dimension from the list. It includes mod dimensions. Game day is the in-game day. Real date is YYYY-MM-DD. /features portal unlock <id>
screen.features.portal_lock.empty: No rules. Every portal is open.
feature.features.elytra_rules.desc: Per dimension: elytra, firework boost, glide time, and creative-style flight.
screen.features.elytra_rules.locked: Only operators can change flight rules.
screen.features.elytra_rules.hint: Pick a dimension. 0 seconds means no time limit. Elytra, firework boost, and creative-style flight can each be turned off.
screen.features.elytra_rules.denied.time: Elytra time in %s is up (%s s)
screen.features.elytra_rules.denied.fire: Firework boost is not allowed in %s
feature.features.mob_drops.desc: Add, remove, or replace drops per mob, tag, or mod, and scale experience.
screen.features.mob_drops.locked: Only operators can change mob drops.
screen.features.mob_drops.hint: Pick a mob. The empty slot adds a drop from the item picker. Chance and count are on each drop. Uncheck to stop it, x removes one you added. Set writes the numbers.
screen.features.mob_drops.no_loot: This mob has no loot table
feature.features.villager_trades.desc: Block trades by profession, remove results, and freeze discounts.
screen.features.villager_trades.locked: Only operators can change villager trades.
screen.features.villager_trades.hint: Pick a profession. Each row shows the price, the result, and its enchantment. Uncheck to forbid that trade. Empty slots open the item picker. The x on a custom trade removes it.
feature.features.item_weight.desc: Carried items have weight. Too much slows you down, stops sprinting, and burns hunger.
screen.features.item_weight.hint: Every item already has a weight. Capacity is how much you can carry. The three lines under it are fractions of that capacity. Strength adds capacity. The empty slot picks an item, then set its weight.
screen.features.item_weight.thresholds: How much you can carry, and when it starts to matter
screen.features.item_weight.empty: No custom weights. Defaults are used.
screen.features.item_weight.capacity.tip: How much weight you can carry before the last threshold.
screen.features.item_weight.slow.tip: Fraction of capacity where movement starts to slow.
screen.features.item_weight.sprint.tip: Fraction of capacity where sprinting stops.
screen.features.item_weight.hunger.tip: Fraction of capacity where hunger starts to drop.
screen.features.item_weight.strength.tip: Extra capacity for each Strength level.
feature.features.server_tweaks.desc: MOTD, tab list, kits, roles, moderation, and basic checks.
screen.features.server_tweaks.motd.tip: Two lines. & codes color the server list. The preview on the right uses the same colors.
Hides the ping bars in the tab list.
screen.features.server_tweaks.sort.tip: Operators, then moderators, then everyone else.
screen.features.server_tweaks.prefix.tip: Gold [Op] and aqua [Mod] in front of the name.
screen.features.server_tweaks.enabled.ti: Join messages, the tab header, kits, and checks run only while this is on.
screen.features.server_tweaks.action.log: Writes the event to the log and leaves the player online.
screen.features.server_tweaks.action.not: Writes the log and tells online operators.
screen.features.server_tweaks.action.kic: Writes the log, tells operators, and disconnects the player.
screen.features.server_tweaks.checks.tip: Every check is off until you enable it. They are loose on purpose so lag and vehicle mods are less likely to trip them.
screen.features.search.empty: Nothing matches. Try another word, or check the keyboard layout.
screen.features.presets.name: Preset name
screen.features.presets.denied: Only operators can apply a preset
config.features.use_features_menu: Configure features in the Features menu (pause → logo).
screen.features.true_night.moon.on.tip: Darkness follows the moon. New moon is the darkest.
screen.features.true_night.darkness.valu: How dark a new moon gets. 100% is the default.
How dark every night is when moon phases are off.
screen.features.real_first_person.offset: Shifts the body while standing. Default is -0.25.
Shifts the body while sneaking. Default is -0.25.
Shifts the body while sitting. Default is -0.25.
Shifts the body while swimming. Default is -0.50.
Shifts the body while gliding. Default is -1.30.
Puts every pose offset back to its default.
screen.features.hide_names.add.tip: Adds the item id from the field to the mask list.
screen.features.hide_names.remove.tip: Removes this item from the mask list.
screen.features.inventory_revamp.add.tip: Gives the picked item extra inventory slots.
Removes the bonus from this item.
screen.features.item_weight.wet.tip: Extra weight on wet armor while Wetness is on.
screen.features.item_weight.slots.tip: How much extra capacity one bonus slot adds.
screen.features.elytra_rules.elytra.tip: Whether elytra flight is allowed in this dimension.
screen.features.portal_lock.op_bypass.ti: Operators can use portals even when a rule blocks them.
screen.features.portal_lock.creation.tip: Stops players from lighting a new portal.
screen.features.portal_lock.mode.block.t: Portals to this dimension do not work.
screen.features.portal_lock.mode.day.tip: The portal opens on this game day.
screen.features.portal_lock.mode.date.ti: The portal opens on this real-world date.
screen.features.interaction_blocker.op_b: Operators can still use blocked blocks and entities.
screen.features.interaction_blocker.open: Blocks opening this block or entity.
Blocks using this block or entity.
Plays a sound when a forbidden tool is used.
screen.features.tool_restrictions.catalo: Click a block or item to forbid it. The focused field decides exceptions or the hand list.
screen.features.tool_restrictions.except: These blocks can still be broken. Click to remove one.
screen.features.tool_restrictions.hand.t: These items may be used in the hand. Click to remove one.
screen.features.item_remover.inventory.t: Deletes the item from player inventories.
screen.features.item_remover.recipes.tip: Hides recipes that make this item.
screen.features.item_remover.loot.tip: Removes the item from loot tables.
screen.features.item_remover.row.tip: Click to ban or allow this item.
screen.features.mob_spawn.row.tip: Click to block or allow this mob.
Shown to the player when a command is blocked.
screen.features.command_blocker.suggesti: Click a command to put it in the field.
Click a row to remove that block.
screen.features.villager_trades.block_jo: Villagers of this job stop trading.
screen.features.villager_trades.freeze.t: Trade prices stay as you set them.
screen.features.mob_drops.clear.tip: Vanilla loot for this mob is removed. Custom drops stay.
screen.features.mob_drops.add_item.tip: Adds an item drop for the selected mob.
screen.features.mob_drops.row.tip: Click the row to edit the chance. The box turns the drop on or off.
Edits the warning lines. Empty text uses the default.
screen.features.border_danger.barrier.fo: Opens the folder with the custom border texture.
screen.features.server_tweaks.fly.tip: Notes a player who gains height without flying permission.
screen.features.server_tweaks.speed.tip: Notes movement that is far faster than walking.
screen.features.server_tweaks.reach.tip: Notes hits and block breaks from too far away.
screen.features.server_tweaks.fall.tip: Notes a landing that should have dealt fall damage.
screen.features.server_tweaks.fast_break: Notes two blocks broken almost in the same tick.
screen.features.server_tweaks.xray.tip: Notes an inventory that is mostly ores.
screen.features.server_tweaks.dupe.tip: Notes an inventory that grows by a huge amount at once.
screen.features.server_tweaks.kick_actio: Kick sends the player out. Otherwise the check only writes a note.
screen.features.server_tweaks.mute.tip: Stops this player from chatting for the given minutes. 0 is forever.
screen.features.server_tweaks.ban.tip: Bans this player. 0 minutes is permanent.
screen.features.server_tweaks.freeze.tip: Stops this player from moving until you freeze them again.
screen.features.server_tweaks.save_kit.t: Saves the nine slots as a kit.
screen.features.server_tweaks.from_inven: Copies your inventory into the kit slots.
screen.features.server_tweaks.edit.tip: Click a slot to replace its item.
